The decisive mistake was at Step 5. The AcademicPublication_Expert claimed to have manually searched Google Scholar, which it cannot do. It then fabricated earliest publications for Pietro Murano and Iram N. The "Can a good player be a good coach?" title is not Murano's work. It also misidentified the relevant author: Pietro Murano's co-author is Iram Naz Khan (the Semantic Scholar entry lists "Murano-Khan"), and the paper's author listing "Iram N" is a truncated name. The correct answer is the first paper of Pietro Murano, "Mapping Human Oriented Information to Software Agents for Online Systems Usage". The fabricated answer was later accepted without real verification, since the search at Step 8 did not return the earliest publication.
